messages.text: Morning. Pulling pipeline numbers for the Friday credit committee pack. I've got 23 deals in active pipeline, about $41.2M total commitments. Does that match what you're seeing in LoanOrigination?
I'm showing 24 on my side. Difference is probably {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0048}}, the operating line renewal. It's sitting in underwriting review, not marked as pipeline yet in your view.
That would do it. Adding it back. So 24 deals, roughly $43.5M. Is the renewal still at the $2.3M ask?
Yes, $2.3M requested. Leaning toward recommending $2.0M given the medium risk rating and the AR aging. Not final until the model refresh finishes.
From the closing side: 6 loans scheduled to fund by end of month, about $9.8M. Two are waiting on title and one on the final KYC sign-off.
Which one is waiting on KYC? If it's {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0197}} I can chase the docs today.
Yep, that's {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0197}}. Missing updated beneficial ownership certification. Everything else is clean and the docs are in DocVault.
Got it, I'll call them this morning and ask for the certification by tomorrow noon.
Heads up on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0016}}: high risk rating, loan on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00034}}. I'd keep that out of the committed-to-close number until the exception memo is approved.
Agreed. I never had it in my 6. It would've been a seventh if it moved, about $1.1M.
Makes sense. I'll show it as a separate line, 'pending exception approval', so committee sees it without it inflating the base.
Quick one on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0251}}: low risk, long-tenured, paying as agreed on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00516}}. They asked about a top-up. Should I count it in pipeline at about $150K?
I'd put it in at 50% probability for now. No application yet, just a conversation. I'll flag it as early stage.
Updated numbers for the pack: 24 deals, $43.5M in pipeline, $9.8M committed to close this month, $1.1M pending exception. I'll drop the sheet in the shared folder by 10.
Perfect, thanks Brandon. I'll review once it's up and send comments before lunch.
